год.en: I haven't been to the theatre for 2 years.

годовщина.en: The book about the director was released on the anniversary of his death.

годовщина.en: In March our company celebrates the 10th anniversary since its foundation.

гол.en: Those kinds of goals go down in history and are remembered by fans for a long time.

голова.en: A great idea came to my mind.

голова.en: He shook his head as a sign of disapproval.

голова.en: Upsetting thoughts in my head didn't let me sleep.

голод.en: A strong feeling of hunger kept me awake.

голод.en: At some point he got used to the constant hunger.

голодать.en: They agreed to send twenty tons of bread to help the starving population.

голодный.en: My children always get naughty when they are hungry.

голодный.en: The celebration was over, but they were still hungry when they left the table.

Our TV is controlled by voice.

голос.en: There was a sound of children’s voices somewhere far away.

гора.en: This water comes from the mountains that’s why it’s so clean.
